parsed.notes: Actual ratio values are not disclosed; the filing states only the limits and that the company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The net leverage ratio also sets the interest rate margins, but here it is also a stated covenant. Additional covenants and minimum availability requirements apply to acquisitions and share repurchases; these are not quantified.
